name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
short: Ancient Shiva temple on the Ganga ghats.
description: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas. Located in Varanasi, Kashi Vishwanath is the center of Shaiva devotion.

name: Kedarnath Temple
short: High altitude temple of Lord Shiva in the Himalayas.
description: A sacred shrine within the Garhwal Himalayan range and part of the Char Dham pilgrimage.

name: Dwarkadhish Temple
short: Ancient Krishna temple in Dwarka town by the Arabian Sea.
description: Believed to be the kingdom of Lord Krishna; a major pilgrimage center on the western coast.
